Name: Azrikam, Son of Azel
Summary: Son of Azel, named among the six sons of Azel.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:38; 1 Chronicles 9:44: Son of Azel, named among the six sons of Azel.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Azrikam stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
